gates_verbatim.I-1: Paired comparison, adjusted vs base, same games, priced at the same as_of_ts, against the CLOSING line: CLV (points and implied-prob), ATS win rate, log-loss delta.
gates_verbatim.I-2: Minimum sample: >= 500 games with a non-zero adjustment in the sealed holdout and >= 2 full seasons; below that the result is INCONCLUSIVE (no claim).
gates_verbatim.I-3: Multiple comparisons: 3 markets x 3 metrics = 9 tests; Holm-Bonferroni at family alpha 0.05. Primary endpoint = mean CLV delta (spread) - stated now, not chosen later.
gates_verbatim.I-4: Decision rule: VALUE PROVEN only if primary endpoint significant after Holm, its 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes 0, and K-4 passes. Anything else = NO CLAIM.
gates_verbatim.I-5: Soft, borderline or insignificant results cannot become a product claim, marketing copy, or a "improves accuracy" statement. Report them as null results.
gates_verbatim.K-2: Metrics, base vs adjusted on the same games: Brier and log loss (win prob); cover reliability for spread and total (predicted cover prob vs actual); reliability diagram in 10 bins with counts.
gates_verbatim.K-3: CIs: block bootstrap by NFL week, 10,000 resamples, 95% percentile CI, paired.
gates_verbatim.K-4: Gate: adjusted must not be worse than base: upper 95% CI of (adj - base) log loss <= 0.002 and Brier <= 0.0005. Calibration slope of adjusted within [0.9, 1.1]. Failing = layer stays off.
